detail.description:
The Hyatt Regency Dubai, located in Deira's heritage area along the Deira Corniche, offers 421 spacious, modern, and stylish rooms and suites with stunning views of Dubai's skyline and the Arabian Gulf.  Regency Club Rooms provide complimentary amenities including wireless internet, access to a private lounge (continental breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres), and boardroom usage.  Hotel amenities include a spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials; an outdoor pool, hot tub, and tennis courts; complimentary wireless internet access; concierge services; babysitting (surcharge); and a complimentary beach shuttle. Dining options include Al Dawaar restaurant, two coffee shops/cafes, and 24-hour room service.  Four bars/lounges and a poolside bar are also available. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies).  The hotel features a business center, limo/town car service, express check-out, and 4000 square meters of event space with 17 meeting rooms.  Free self-parking is available onsite, and a 24-hour airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Guest rooms include minibars, espresso makers, satellite programming, private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets.  The hotel is within a 5-minute drive of the Gold Souk and Al Ghurair Centre, and a short walk from the gold, spice, and textile souks. Dubai International Airport (DXB) is 8 km away.  Gold Souq Metro station is a 7-minute walk or a short complimentary shuttle ride away (availability permitting).

The Hyatt Regency Hotel Dubai Deira is a  hotel.
